headline: Russia and Ukraine Agree to Local Ceasefire as Peace Talks Are Planned
summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a local ceasefire as preparations begin for a new round of peace negotiations, according to Reuters reports.
why: The conflict between Russia and Ukraine has major ramifications for global energy prices, European security, agricultural supplies, and cross-border trade flows.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Progress toward a ceasefire eases geopolitical risk premiums embedded in global oil prices.

why_moved: Announcements of a local ceasefire and fresh diplomatic negotiations immediately depressed risk premiums across energy and agricultural commodities.
